issues.description: Field 'lectureName' has conflicting types across artifacts. In the UML class diagram inside problem_statement.md the attribute is declared as 'lectureName: int' (problem_statement.md line 64). However, the toString example in the same problem statement treats lectureName as a String (e.g. "Lecture{lectureName='Introduction to Programming', ...}", problem_statement.md lines 36-39), and the solution implementation declares the field as a String (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 6: 'private String lectureName;'). This inconsistency will confuse students about whether to implement lectureName as an int or a String.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML in problem_statement.md so the lectureName attribute is declared as a String (e.g. '-lectureName: String') to match the textual examples and the solution implementation. Review the problem statement and examples to ensure all references to lectureName consistently treat it as a String.
